tianjingsha_qiusi.zh: 枯萎的藤蔓，古老的樹，黃昏歸巢的烏鴉。
tianjingsha_qiusi.en: Withered vines, old trees, evening crows.
tianjingsha_qiusi.simp: 枯萎的藤蔓，古老的树，黄昏归巢的乌鸦。

tianjingsha_qiusi.en: A small bridge, flowing water, a few houses.

tianjingsha_qiusi.zh: 古老的道路，西風，一匹瘦馬。
tianjingsha_qiusi.en: An ancient road, the west wind, a lean horse.
tianjingsha_qiusi.simp: 古老的道路，西风，一匹瘦马。

tianjingsha_qiusi.src: 夕陽西下，斷腸人在天涯。
tianjingsha_qiusi.zh: 夕陽向西落下，心碎的遊子還在天涯。
tianjingsha_qiusi.en: The sun sinks in the west; a heartbroken traveller is still at the edge of the sky.
tianjingsha_qiusi.simp: 夕阳向西落下，心碎的游子还在天涯。

shanpoyang_tongguan.src: 峰巒如聚，波濤如怒，山河表裏潼關路。
shanpoyang_tongguan.zh: 山峰重重疊疊，像聚攏在一起，黃河波濤洶湧，像在發怒，山河內外環抱著通向潼關的道路。
shanpoyang_tongguan.en: Peaks and ridges crowd together, the waves surge as if in anger, and mountains and river hold the road to Tongguan on both sides.
shanpoyang_tongguan.simp: 山峰重重叠叠，像聚拢在一起，黄河波涛汹涌，像在发怒，山河内外环抱着通向潼关的道路。

shanpoyang_tongguan.zh: 遠望西邊的長安，心中徘徊不定。
shanpoyang_tongguan.en: I look towards the western capital, and my mind wavers.
shanpoyang_tongguan.simp: 远望西边的长安，心中徘徊不定。

shanpoyang_tongguan.src: 傷心秦漢經行處，宮闕萬間都做了土。
shanpoyang_tongguan.zh: 最令人傷心的，是秦漢兩代曾經走過的地方，萬間宮殿都化成了塵土。
shanpoyang_tongguan.en: Heartbreaking are the places Qin and Han once passed, where ten thousand palaces have all turned to dust.
shanpoyang_tongguan.simp: 最令人伤心的，是秦汉两代曾经走过的地方，万间宫殿都化成了尘土。

shanpoyang_tongguan.zh: 朝代興盛，百姓受苦；朝代滅亡，百姓也受苦。
shanpoyang_tongguan.en: When a dynasty rises, the people suffer; when it falls, the people suffer.
shanpoyang_tongguan.simp: 朝代兴盛，百姓受苦；朝代灭亡，百姓也受苦。

shanpoyang_lishan.src: 驪山四顧，阿房一炬，當時奢侈今何處？
shanpoyang_lishan.zh: 站在驪山四面眺望，阿房宮被一把火燒盡，當年的奢華如今在哪裡？
shanpoyang_lishan.en: I look all round from Mount Li: the Epang Palace went up in one torch of fire - where is the extravagance of those days now?
shanpoyang_lishan.simp: 站在骊山四面眺望，阿房宫被一把火烧尽，当年的奢华如今在哪里？

shanpoyang_lishan.zh: 只見荒草稀疏，流水彎彎繞繞。
shanpoyang_lishan.en: I see only sparse grass and a winding stream.
shanpoyang_lishan.simp: 只见荒草稀疏，流水弯弯绕绕。

shanpoyang_lishan.zh: 至今遺留的怨恨，仍迷茫在煙霧籠罩的樹林之間。
shanpoyang_lishan.en: To this day old regret lingers, lost among the misty trees.
shanpoyang_lishan.simp: 至今遗留的怨恨，仍迷茫在烟雾笼罩的树林之间。

shanpoyang_lishan.en: The contending states: Zhou, Qi, Qin, Han, Chu.
The winners all turned to dust;
the losers all turned to dust.

shouyangqu_yuanpu.src: 夕陽下，酒旆閑，兩三航未曾著岸。
shouyangqu_yuanpu.zh: 夕陽西下，酒旗悠閒地垂著，兩三條船還沒有靠岸。
shouyangqu_yuanpu.en: Beneath the setting sun, the wine-shop banner hangs idle, and two or three boats have not yet reached the shore.
shouyangqu_yuanpu.simp: 夕阳西下，酒旗悠闲地垂着，两三条船还没有靠岸。

shouyangqu_yuanpu.src: 落花水香茅舍晚，斷橋頭賣魚人散。
shouyangqu_yuanpu.zh: 落花飄在水上，水也帶著花香，茅屋在暮色裡；斷橋頭賣魚的人已經散去。
shouyangqu_yuanpu.en: Blossoms fall and the water is fragrant, with thatched cottages in the evening; at the head of the broken bridge, the fish-sellers have dispersed.
shouyangqu_yuanpu.simp: 落花飘在水上，水也带着花香，茅屋在暮色里；断桥头卖鱼的人已经散去。

shouyangqu_shanshi.src: 花村外，草店西，晚霞明雨收天霽。
shouyangqu_shanshi.zh: 在開滿鮮花的村子外面，草舍酒店的西邊，晚霞明亮，雨停了，天放晴了。
shouyangqu_shanshi.en: Outside the flowering village, west of the thatched inn, the sunset glow is bright, the rain has stopped and the sky has cleared.
shouyangqu_shanshi.simp: 在开满鲜花的村子外面，草舍酒店的西边，晚霞明亮，雨停了，天放晴了。

shouyangqu_shanshi.src: 四圍山一竿殘照裏，錦屏風又添鋪翠。
shouyangqu_shanshi.zh: 四周的群山籠罩在一竿高的殘陽裡，像一道錦繡屏風，又添上一層翠綠。
shouyangqu_shanshi.en: Mountains all around, in the last light a pole's height above the horizon, are like a brocade screen with a fresh layer of green spread over it.
shouyangqu_shanshi.simp: 四周的群山笼罩在一竿高的残阳里，像一道锦绣屏风，又添上一层翠绿。

shouyangqu_pingsha.src: 南傳信，北寄書，半棲近岸花汀樹。
shouyangqu_pingsha.zh: 大雁向南方傳遞音信，向北方寄送書信，有的半棲息在近岸開花的沙洲樹上。
shouyangqu_pingsha.en: Carrying word to the south, sending letters to the north, half of the wild geese rest on the shore, in the trees of the flowery sandbar.
shouyangqu_pingsha.simp: 大雁向南方传递音信，向北方寄送书信，有的半栖息在近岸开花的沙洲树上。

shouyangqu_pingsha.src: 似鴛鴦失群迷伴侶，兩三行海門斜去。
shouyangqu_pingsha.zh: 像失去了同伴、迷失了伴侶的鴛鴦，有兩三行斜斜地朝海口飛去。
shouyangqu_pingsha.en: Like mandarin ducks that have lost the flock and their mates, two or three lines slant away towards the mouth of the sea.
shouyangqu_pingsha.simp: 像失去了同伴、迷失了伴侣的鸳鸯，有两三行斜斜地朝海口飞去。

shouyangqu_jiangtian.src: 天將暮，雪亂舞，半梅花半飄柳絮。
shouyangqu_jiangtian.zh: 天色將近傍晚，雪花紛亂飛舞，一半像梅花，一半像飄飛的柳絮。
shouyangqu_jiangtian.en: Evening is coming on, snow dances wildly, half like plum blossom, half like drifting willow floss.
shouyangqu_jiangtian.simp: 天色将近傍晚，雪花纷乱飞舞，一半像梅花，一半像飘飞的柳絮。

shouyangqu_jiangtian.src: 江上晚來堪畫處，鉤魚人一蓑歸去。
shouyangqu_jiangtian.zh: 傍晚的江上，是最值得入畫的地方，釣魚的人披著一件蓑衣回家去。
shouyangqu_jiangtian.en: The river at dusk is a place worth painting: an angler in a straw cape goes home.
shouyangqu_jiangtian.simp: 傍晚的江上，是最值得入画的地方，钓鱼的人披着一件蓑衣回家去。

shouyangqu_dongting.src: 蘆花謝，客乍別，泛蟾光小舟一葉。
shouyangqu_dongting.zh: 蘆花凋謝了，客人剛剛告別，月光下漂浮著一葉小舟。
shouyangqu_dongting.en: The reed blossoms have faded, the traveller has just said farewell, and a leaf of a boat floats on the moonlight.
shouyangqu_dongting.simp: 芦花凋谢了，客人刚刚告别，月光下漂浮着一叶小舟。

shouyangqu_dongting.src: 豫章城故人來也，結末了洞庭秋月。
shouyangqu_dongting.zh: 豫章城的老朋友來了，洞庭湖的秋月之景也就此收尾。
shouyangqu_dongting.en: An old friend comes to Yuzhang city - and so the autumn moon on Dongting is brought to its close.
shouyangqu_dongting.simp: 豫章城的老朋友来了，洞庭湖的秋月之景也就此收尾。

shouyangqu_yucun.src: 鳴榔罷，閃暮光，綠楊堤數聲漁唱。
shouyangqu_yucun.zh: 敲船驅魚的聲音停了，夕陽的光影閃動，綠楊堤上傳來幾聲漁人的歌唱。
shouyangqu_yucun.en: The tapping on the boat sides has stopped, the evening light flickers, and on the green-willow embankment come a few snatches of fishermen's song.
shouyangqu_yucun.simp: 敲船驱鱼的声音停了，夕阳的光影闪动，绿杨堤上传来几声渔人的歌唱。

shouyangqu_yucun.src: 掛柴門幾家閑曬網，都撮在捕魚圖上。
shouyangqu_yucun.zh: 柴門前掛著幾戶人家閒晾的漁網，都收進了這幅捕魚的畫裡。
shouyangqu_yucun.en: Outside brushwood gates, nets hang idle to dry in several households, all gathered into a picture of fishing.
shouyangqu_yucun.simp: 柴门前挂着几户人家闲晾的渔网，都收进了这幅捕鱼的画里。

shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.src: 漁燈暗，客夢回，一聲聲滴人心碎。
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.zh: 漁船上的燈光昏暗，旅人從夢中醒來，一聲聲雨滴使人心碎。
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.en: The fishing lamp burns low, the traveller wakes from his dream, and drop after drop of rain breaks the heart.
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.simp: 渔船上的灯光昏暗，旅人从梦中醒来，一声声雨滴使人心碎。

shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.src: 孤舟五更家萬里，是離人幾行清淚。
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.zh: 孤舟漂泊在五更天，家鄉遠在萬里之外，那是離家人流下的幾行清淚。
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.en: A lone boat at the fifth watch, home ten thousand li away - how many lines of clear tears fall from one who is far from home.
shouyangqu_xiaoxiang.simp: 孤舟漂泊在五更天，家乡远在万里之外，那是离家人流下的几行清泪。

shouyangqu_yansi.src: 寒煙細，古寺清，近黃昏禮佛人靜。
shouyangqu_yansi.zh: 寒煙細細，古寺清幽，臨近黃昏，禮佛的人都靜了下來。
shouyangqu_yansi.en: Cold mist is thin, the old temple is clear and still, and near dusk the worshippers have gone quiet.
shouyangqu_yansi.simp: 寒烟细细，古寺清幽，临近黄昏，礼佛的人都静了下来。

shouyangqu_yansi.src: 順西風晚鐘三四聲，怎生教老僧禪定？
shouyangqu_yansi.zh: 順著西風傳來三四聲晚鐘，怎能叫老和尚安然入定呢？
shouyangqu_yansi.en: Down the west wind come three or four strokes of the evening bell - how could the old monk possibly stay in meditation?
shouyangqu_yansi.simp: 顺着西风传来三四声晚钟，怎能叫老和尚安然入定呢？

sikuaiyu_bieqing.src: 自送別，心難舍，一點相思幾時絕？
sikuaiyu_bieqing.zh: 自從送別以後，心中難以割捨，這一點相思什麼時候才能斷絕？
sikuaiyu_bieqing.en: Since I saw him off, my heart can hardly let go; when will this one thread of longing end?
sikuaiyu_bieqing.simp: 自从送别以后，心中难以割舍，这一点相思什么时候才能断绝？

sikuaiyu_bieqing.zh: 我倚著欄杆，用衣袖拂去如雪的楊花。
sikuaiyu_bieqing.en: Leaning on the rail, I brush the willow-down like snow from my sleeve.
sikuaiyu_bieqing.simp: 我倚着栏杆，用衣袖拂去如雪的杨花。

sikuaiyu_bieqing.zh: 溪水又彎彎曲曲，山又擋住了視線，人已經走了啊！
sikuaiyu_bieqing.en: The stream bends away, the hills block the view - he is gone!
sikuaiyu_bieqing.simp: 溪水又弯弯曲曲，山又挡住了视线，人已经走了啊！

chenzuidongfeng.src: 黃蘆岸白蘋渡口，綠楊紅蓼灘頭。
chenzuidongfeng.zh: 黃色的蘆葦長在岸邊，白蘋生在渡口，綠楊和紅蓼生在灘頭。
chenzuidongfeng.en: Yellow reeds on the bank, white duckweed at the ford, green willows and red knotweed on the sandbar.
chenzuidongfeng.simp: 黄色的芦苇长在岸边，白苹生在渡口，绿杨和红蓼生在滩头。

chenzuidongfeng.src: 雖無刎頸交，卻有忘機友，
chenzuidongfeng.zh: 雖然沒有刎頸之交，卻有忘卻機心的朋友，
chenzuidongfeng.en: I have no friends sworn to die together, but I have friends who have forgotten scheming:
chenzuidongfeng.simp: 虽然没有刎颈之交，却有忘却机心的朋友，

chenzuidongfeng.src: 點秋江白鷺沙鷗，傲殺人間萬戶侯，不識字煙波釣叟。
chenzuidongfeng.zh: 白鷺和沙鷗點綴著秋天的江面，牠們傲視人間的萬戶侯，還有那個不識字的、在煙波上釣魚的老漁翁。
chenzuidongfeng.en: white egrets and gulls dotting the autumn river, who look down on the marquises of ten thousand households in the human world - and an unlettered old angler on the misty waves.
chenzuidongfeng.simp: 白鹭和沙鸥点缀着秋天的江面，牠们傲视人间的万户侯，还有那个不识字的、在烟波上钓鱼的老渔翁。

pinglanren.src: 欲寄君衣君不還，不寄君衣君又寒。
pinglanren.zh: 想把衣服寄給你，你又不回來；不把衣服寄給你，你又會受凍。
pinglanren.en: If I send you clothes, you will not come home; if I do not send them, you will be cold.
pinglanren.simp: 想把衣服寄给你，你又不回来；不把衣服寄给你，你又会受冻。

pinglanren.src: 寄與不寄間，妾身千萬難！
pinglanren.zh: 寄還是不寄，其中的為難，我這個女子真是千難萬難！
pinglanren.en: Between sending and not sending, how hard it is for me, a thousand times over!
pinglanren.simp: 寄还是不寄，其中的为难，我这个女子真是千难万难！

tianjingsha_chun.src: 春山暖日和風，闌幹樓閣簾櫳，楊柳秋千院中。
tianjingsha_chun.zh: 春天的山，溫暖的太陽，柔和的風，欄杆、樓閣、窗簾，庭院裡楊柳下的鞦韆。
tianjingsha_chun.en: Spring hills, a warm sun and a gentle wind, railings, towers and curtained windows, willows and a swing in the courtyard.
tianjingsha_chun.simp: 春天的山，温暖的太阳，柔和的风，栏杆、楼阁、窗帘，庭院里杨柳下的秋千。

tianjingsha_chun.src: 啼鶯舞燕，小橋流水飛紅。
tianjingsha_chun.zh: 黃鶯啼叫，燕子飛舞，小橋流水，落花紛飛。
tianjingsha_chun.en: Orioles sing, swallows dance; a small bridge, flowing water, flying red petals.
tianjingsha_chun.simp: 黄莺啼叫，燕子飞舞，小桥流水，落花纷飞。

tianjingsha_xia.src: 雲收雨過波添，樓高水冷瓜甜，綠樹陰垂畫簷。
tianjingsha_xia.zh: 雲散了，雨停了，水波漲了起來，樓高水涼瓜果香甜，綠樹的陰影低垂在彩繪的屋簷上。
tianjingsha_xia.en: Clouds gone, rain passed, the water risen; the tower is high, the water cool, the melon sweet, and green tree-shade hangs over the painted eaves.
tianjingsha_xia.simp: 云散了，雨停了，水波涨了起来，楼高水凉瓜果香甜，绿树的阴影低垂在彩绘的屋檐上。

tianjingsha_xia.src: 紗幮藤簟，玉人羅扇輕縑。
tianjingsha_xia.zh: 紗帳，藤蓆，美人拿著羅扇，穿著輕薄的細絹衣裳。
tianjingsha_xia.en: A gauze net, a rattan mat, and a jade-fair beauty with a silk fan and thin silk dress.
tianjingsha_xia.simp: 纱帐，藤席，美人拿着罗扇，穿着轻薄的细绢衣裳。

tianjingsha_qiu.src: 孤村落日殘霞，輕煙老樹寒鴉，一點飛鴻影下。
tianjingsha_qiu.zh: 孤零零的村子，落日和殘霞，輕煙，老樹，寒鴉，一隻飛雁的影子掠過天際。
tianjingsha_qiu.en: A lone village, the setting sun, the last of the sunset glow, light smoke, old trees, cold crows, the shadow of a single wild goose drops below.
tianjingsha_qiu.simp: 孤零零的村子，落日和残霞，轻烟，老树，寒鸦，一只飞雁的影子掠过天际。

tianjingsha_qiu.src: 青山綠水，白草紅葉黃花。
tianjingsha_qiu.zh: 青山，綠水，白草，紅葉，黃花。
tianjingsha_qiu.en: Green hills and green water, white grass, red leaves, yellow flowers.
tianjingsha_qiu.simp: 青山，绿水，白草，红叶，黄花。

tianjingsha_dong.src: 一聲畫角樵門，半亭新月黃昏，雪裏山前水濱。
tianjingsha_dong.zh: 一聲號角從城門樓上傳來，黃昏時半輪新月掛在亭邊，雪中的山前，水邊。
tianjingsha_dong.en: A call of the painted horn from the watchtower gate, a new moon half seen above the pavilion at dusk, in the snow, before the hills, at the water's edge.
tianjingsha_dong.simp: 一声号角从城门楼上传来，黄昏时半轮新月挂在亭边，雪中的山前，水边。

tianjingsha_dong.src: 竹籬茅舍，淡煙衰草孤村。
tianjingsha_dong.zh: 竹籬笆，茅草屋，淡淡的煙霧，枯衰的野草，一座孤零零的村子。
tianjingsha_dong.en: A bamboo fence, thatched cottages, pale smoke, withered grass, a lone village.
tianjingsha_dong.simp: 竹篱笆，茅草屋，淡淡的烟雾，枯衰的野草，一座孤零零的村子。
